# Table column width annotations

MD_FLAG_TABLECOLUMNWIDTHS allows an annotation immediately after each separator
cell, including its optional alignment colon. Width tokens are exposed through
MD_BLOCK_TABLE_DETAIL.columns; consumers interpret their values. The HTML
renderer preserves table structure and alignment without applying widths.

```````````````````````````````` example
| Name | Description | Notes |
| ---{100pt} | ---{1fr} | ---{2fr} |
| A | Example | Memo |
.
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Name</th><th>Description</th><th>Notes</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>A</td><td>Example</td><td>Memo</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
.
--ftable-column-widths
````````````````````````````````

The extension is opt-in and is not enabled by MD_FLAG_TABLES alone.

```````````````````````````````` example
| A | B |
| ---{100pt} | ---{1fr} |
.
<p>| A | B |
| ---{100pt} | ---{1fr} |</p>
.
--ftables
````````````````````````````````

Alignment and omitted annotations work together, with optional outer pipes.

```````````````````````````````` example
Left | Center | Right
:---{ 100pt } | :---:{auto} | ---:
a | b | c
.
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th align="left">Left</th><th align="center">Center</th><th align="right">Right</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td align="left">a</td><td align="center">b</td><td align="right">c</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
.
--ftable-column-widths
````````````````````````````````

Tokens are opaque to MD4C, even when they contain a dash or are empty.

```````````````````````````````` example
| A | B |
| ---{custom-width} | ---:{} |
.
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>A</th><th align="right">B</th></tr>
</thead>
</table>
.
--ftable-column-widths
````````````````````````````````

Nested tables retain their annotations and fill missing cells.

```````````````````````````````` example
> | A | B |
> | ---{auto} | ---{2fr} |
> | x |
.
<blockquote>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>A</th><th>B</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>x</td><td></td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</blockquote>
.
--ftable-column-widths
````````````````````````````````

An annotation must close on the same line and cannot contain a pipe or brace.

```````````````````````````````` example
| A | B |
| ---{100pt | ---{1fr} |
.
<p>| A | B |
| ---{100pt | ---{1fr} |</p>
.
--ftable-column-widths
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
| A | B |
| ---{100pt
} | ---{1fr} |
.
<p>| A | B |
| ---{100pt
} | ---{1fr} |</p>
.
--ftable-column-widths
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
| A | B |
| ---{{100pt}} | ---{1fr} |
.
<p>| A | B |
| ---{{100pt}} | ---{1fr} |</p>
.
--ftable-column-widths
````````````````````````````````
